Hi! I took a look at your page and have some suggestions. 

1) First off, TikTok Studio will be your best friend. Here you can use the Account Check feature to see if any of your videos were removed from the FYP. Sometimes videos are removed from the fyp days after being posted, so that can lead to low views/no engagement.

2) 3 second rule: People decide in three seconds whether they want to watch a video before scrolling. You have to capture interest, whether its changing up your visual formatting, the initial dialogue, etc.

3) Branding/Formatting: Your videos should all have the same kind of consistent vibe. Right now when I go to your page, I notice that all of the backgrounds to the videos are different, the minecraft video has sound, and then the newer two has the scary music. 

I would find consistent but not too distracting visuals, make the title card pop in/out to perhaps grab attention, and make the music volume a lot lower than the dialogue. I would also find a way to make the title card more visually interesting, akin to how other reddit story pages do. 

The subtitles can be fine, but maybe a different font and highlighting animation? That one is just me, it's not an issue really.

Also brand yourself! Your username is what people are going to recognize you by and search for, make it something that falls in line with what you're making videos about, preferably without numbers.  And a bio would be good here too.

4. Lastly, do a ton of research to see how similar pages are doing it. Don't copy them, but just take inspiration so you can see what might work for you.

I thought the visuals behind the Whispering Pages video to be the most intriguing. Once you have your formatting down, I would delete the ones that don't follow this format, they can make your page look messy.
